datasets.name: Planet satellite imagery
datasets.verbatim: The satellite remote sensing images in this paper were downloaded from Planet satellite (https://www.planet.com/explorer/ (accessed on 18 September 2018))

datasets.name: Landslide sample dataset with 4000 tags
datasets.verbatim: A landslide sample dataset with 4000 tags was produced.

methods.name: YOLOv3 convolutional neural network
methods.summary: A convolutional neural network based on the YOLOv3 architecture, implemented using the TensorFlow framework, designed to automatically identify co-seismic landslides in satellite remote sensing images by treating detection as a regression problem.
methods.verbatim: With YOLOv3 algorithm as the core, a convolutional neural network model with landslide characteristics was established to automatically recognize co-seismic landslides in satellite remote sensing images. ... TensorFlow [27] platform was used to construct the convolutional neural network, and YOLOv3 convolutional neural network to train the sample set.

availability.author_statement: Data availability statement present with no links.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom YOLOv3 implementation code is not available.
